card.name: Quantifiers like all and any
card.fires_on: The words all and any (and nearby words like every or entire-set nouns) used as a quantifier before a noun phrase meaning the whole group. Seen in both drug-label and general web prose.

modes.label: all/any before a noun
modes.description: The quantifier all or any comes right before a noun that it covers fully.
modes.example: Keep tranylcypromine sulfate tablets and<< all>> medicines out of the reach of children.

modes.label: Other words in whole-set phrases
modes.description: Words like corners, years or children that follow all, every or earliest in phrases that span a whole range.
modes.example: In all<< corners>> of the globe, women work tirelessly —

modes.label: all inside a word
modes.description: The start of the word allergic, split after the letters all.
modes.example: hypersensitive (<<all>>ergic) to the local anesthetic or
